newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says to buy 40,000 tonnes corn.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says to buy 40,000 tonnes corn.

text.p: The Philippines' National Food Authority said on Monday it will buy 40,000 tonnes of corn for shipment not later than April 15.
The state-owned firm said in an announcement in Philippine newspapers it planned to hold a bidding for the supply of 15,000 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn number 2 on April 2.
It also said it will seek tenders for the supply of 25,000 tonnes white kernelled corn.
The National Food Authority said it planned to hold a pre-bidding on the proposed corn importation on Monday.
